name: get-actor-run-widget
description:
Render an interactive UI element (widget) that displays live progress and status of an Actor run.

The tool returns immediately after rendering the widget — it never blocks waiting for the run.
The widget itself polls run status and updates in place until the run reaches a terminal state.

Use this tool ONLY when the user explicitly wants to see run progress visually
(e.g., "show progress for run y2h7sK3Wc", "display the status of that run").

For silent data lookups (run status, dataset IDs, stats, resource IDs), use
get-actor-run instead — it returns the same data without rendering a widget.

runId.description: The ID of the Actor run.

apifyConsoleUrl.description: Personalized Apify Console link to the run; present only for Console sessions

actorId.description: Stable Apify Actor ID from the run record

status.description: Run status: READY | RUNNING | TIMING-OUT | TIMED-OUT | ABORTING | ABORTED | SUCCEEDED | FAILED

exitCode.description: Actor process exit code; populated for terminal states (especially FAILED)

startedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the run started

finishedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the run finished (terminal states only)

storages.description: Dataset and key-value store metadata, keyed by alias. "default" is always the primary entry.

datasets.description: Map of dataset alias → metadata. Key "default" is always the run's primary dataset.

apifyConsoleUrl.description: Personalized Apify Console link to the dataset; present only for Console sessions

inflatedBytes.description: Approximate uncompressed byte size of the dataset. Use with itemCount to pick limit/fields before fetching.

fields.description: Dataset field paths in dot notation (e.g. ["metadata.url"])

apifyConsoleUrl.description: Personalized Apify Console link to the dataset; present only for Console sessions

inflatedBytes.description: Approximate uncompressed byte size of the dataset. Use with itemCount to pick limit/fields before fetching.

fields.description: Dataset field paths in dot notation (e.g. ["metadata.url"])

keyValueStores.description: Map of key-value store alias → metadata. Key "default" is always the run's primary store.

apifyConsoleUrl.description: Personalized Apify Console link to the store; present only for Console sessions

keyCount.description: Total number of keys (omitted when truncated)

apifyConsoleUrl.description: Personalized Apify Console link to the store; present only for Console sessions

keyCount.description: Total number of keys (omitted when truncated)

summary.description: Past-tense summary of the run state

nextStep.description: One primary follow-up action with identifiers interpolated
